title: fix(service-analytics): the draft preview groups a bucketed time dimension and reads a qualified filter member as the live faces do; ObjectQL serves a backed RELATION.id dimension
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XB1hsVtuncZ5F5C4zpiftHC)_

Fixes #28690
Fixes #28691
Fixes #28692

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` describes how the draft preview groups a time dimension or reads a qualified filter member, or says the ObjectQL strategy refuses a `RELATION.id` dimension.

Card thread: `session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据集查询三条执行面（原生 SQL、ObjectQL、草稿预览）的三处不一致收齐。① 草稿预览对带粒度的 `timeDimensions` 按桶分组，不再要求它同时出现在 `dimensions` 里，`fields` 里也带上这一列。② 草稿预览遇到 `对象名.region`、`数据集名.region`、或声明在 `region` 上的维度 `zone` 这类筛选成员，改为读它真正对应的列（按该列的声明类型比较），不再返回 `[]`。③ ObjectQL 策略对 `account.id` 维度、以及同一关系上的两个维度（`account.id` + `account.name`，或 `account` + `account.name`），groupBy 只写一次那一列，不再被引擎以「重复列」拒绝。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28690、#28691、#28692（p3），是 #28555 开发时在真 SQLite 上测到的同族缺口：作者在草稿里看到一个总数，发布后变成按月分组；草稿里一个能用的筛选什么都不返回；同一个查询原生面能答、ObjectQL 面 400。
- **风险与回滚**：只放宽，不收窄：之前给错数或 `[]` 的现在给线上同样的答案，之前 `INVALID_QUERY` 的现在服务。引擎的重复 groupBy 拒绝原样保留（改在策略里，不碰 `packages/objectql`）。预览仍拒绝经关系路径读的成员（#28555）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts` 分组段（改用共享的 `projectedDimensions`）与新的 `whereColumns` 参数；`analytics-service.ts` 新的 `previewWhereColumns`；`strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` 的 `executeCrossObject` 与 `resolveFkAttr` 两处 groupBy。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts`，预期 17 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **#28690 — `preview-evaluator.ts`.** The grouping set is now `projectedDimensions(query)` from `order-key-door.ts`, the one definition the ObjectQL strategy's grouping, row mapping and `buildFieldMeta` already read: every `dimensions` entry, then every `timeDimensions` entry with a granularity that is not already one of them. The evaluator's `fields` list reads the same set, so the bucket column carries the cube dimension's type (`time` for a `date` dataset dimension), as on the live faces. A `timeDimensions` entry without a granularity still only contributes its window.
- **#28691 — resolve, not refuse.** The order allowed either. Both live strategies serve these members (measured below), so the preview now resolves them. `previewWhereColumns(query, cube)` (new, module-level in `analytics-service.ts`) reads the `where` leaves with the reader the strategies compile with (`normalizeAnalyticsFilterTree` + `collectFilterLeaves`, as `relationshipMembers` reads them) and resolves each with `declaredMemberEntry(cube, member, 'any')`, the strategies' filter-member lookup that `assertWhereFields` and the dimension face's `previewEvaluationCube` already use. Each member spelled other than its bare column (`OBJECT.region`, `CUBE.region`, `zone` over `region`) maps to that column. The evaluator takes the map as a new optional last argument `whereColumns`: the `where` match reads each listed member from its column, and the declared-type reader used by the `where` lowering and the storage-form comparison reads the column's declaration. No `where` tree is rewritten or walked a second time; the time window and grouping read columns as before. A member that resolves to no declared entry, an expression or a relationship path is not listed (the latter is refused earlier by #28555's gates).
- **#28692 — `strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`, where the duplicate enters.** Two places built a `groupBy` naming one column twice, and the engine's guard refused it (`groupBy.1 names the column '…', which groupBy.0 already names`, `INVALID_QUERY`): `resolveFkAttr` grouped the related object by `['id', attr]`, which is `['id', 'id']` for `RELATION.id`; and `executeCrossObject` pushed a cross-object dimension's FK column once per dimension, so `account.id` beside `account.name` (both FK `account`) pushed `account` twice, and a base dimension over the FK column (`account` beside `account.name`) did the same. Now `resolveFkAttr` groups `['id']` when `attr` is `id`, and the cross-object `groupBy` names an FK column once (a base dimension over a column already grouped as an FK reuses it). The re-bucket reads the one column for each dimension, as before. Nothing in `packages/objectql` changes, so its duplicate-groupBy refusal is unchanged and there are no other callers of a changed function to measure.
- Tests: new `src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts` (17 cases, real SQLite, the #28201 / #28258 / #28555 harness).
- Changeset `.changeset/28690-preview-time-buckets-filter-columns-fk-id.md`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `d62d9737` (real SQLite, every face), with a probe printing each face's answer per selection. Dataset over a deal object (`region`, `amount`, `closed_at` datetime, `account` lookup), rows amer/2026-03-01/100/a1, amer/2026-04-01/50/a2, emea/2026-04-02/30/a1; dimensions `region`, `closed_at` (date), `zone` (field `region`).

<details><summary>Before / after per selection</summary>

| selection | native | ObjectQL | preview before | preview / ObjectQL after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| td `closed_at` month, no dims | 2026-03:100, 2026-04:80 | same | one row, total 180 | preview = live |
| dim `region` + td `closed_at` month | (amer,03,100) (amer,04,50) (emea,04,30) | same | grouped by region only | preview = live |
| td `OBJECT.closed_at` month | keyed `OBJECT.closed_at`, 03:100, 04:80 | same | one row, total 180 | preview = live |
| td `closed_at` year + April window | `2026`:80 | same | total 80, no key | preview = live |
| td in dims too; td window only; `dateGranularity` | agree | agree | agreed already | unchanged |
| filter `OBJECT.region` / `CUBE.region` / `zone` = emea | emea 30 | same | `[]` | preview = live |
| `$or` [`OBJECT.region` $in emea, amount 50] | amer 50, emea 30 | same | amer 50 only | preview = live |
| `OBJECT.closed_at` $gte 2026-04-01 | amer 50, emea 30 | same | `[]` | preview = live |
| backed dim `account.id` | a1:130, a2:50 | `INVALID_QUERY` (groupBy 'id' twice on the account object) | refused (#28555) | ObjectQL = native; preview still refuses |
| backed `account.id` + `account.name` | served | `INVALID_QUERY` (groupBy 'account' twice) | refused | ObjectQL = native |
| backed `account` + `account.name` (either order) | served | `INVALID_QUERY` | refused | ObjectQL = native |

</details>

## Tests

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablations</summary>

- Red on base: the three production files restored to `d62d9737` (`git checkout d62d9737 -- …`), the new test at HEAD: `Tests 15 failed | 2 passed (17)`. The two green are the controls (a window-only time dimension, the preview's #28555 refusal). Each #28690/#28691 case fails on the preview leg, each #28692 case on the ObjectQL leg with the engine's duplicate-column message. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status` clean.
- Green: `17 passed (17)`.
- Ablations at `de8aeea7` (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first, each anchor 1 → 0, restore blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty; the suite imports `src`, no build between):
  - A1 grouping set back to `query.dimensions ?? []`: `5 failed | 12 passed` (the four bucket cases and the `zone` + bucket case).
  - A2 `--delete` the `previewWhereColumns(q, cube)` argument: `7 failed | 10 passed` (the six filter cases and the `zone` + bucket case).
  - A2b the `where` type reader back to `declaredType` (members read from their columns but typed as written): `1 failed | 16 passed` (the `OBJECT.closed_at` instant comparison with an offset comparand).
  - A3a `resolveFkAttr` back to `['id', attr]`: `2 failed | 15 passed` (`account.id`, `account.id` + `account.name`).
  - A3b the FK column pushed once per cross dimension again: `2 failed | 15 passed` (`account.id` + `account.name`, `account` before `account.name`).
  - A3c the base-dimension reuse of an FK column off: `1 failed | 16 passed` (`account` after `account.name`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run` at `de8aeea7`: `Test Files 203 passed (203)`, `Tests 4856 passed | 282 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics` (after `--filter '@objectstack/rest^...' --filter @objectstack/service-analytics` build): `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 298 passed | 22 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` (includes `__tests__`, after a full build) exit 0; `eslint` on the four touched source and test files exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- #28691 went the "resolve" way: both live strategies serve every measured spelling, so a refusal would have narrowed the preview below them. The resolution is `declaredMemberEntry`, the lookup the strategies mirror and the preview's dimension face already uses; the leaves come from the strategies' own reader. No second walker: the `where` tree is not rewritten, the evaluator reads a listed member from its column at the match.
- #28692's fix is in the strategy, where the duplicate enters. `packages/objectql` is not touched, so its duplicate-groupBy refusal stands and no other caller moves.
- Out of scope, measured on `400154ac` (real SQLite), not fixed: two dataset dimensions over one base column (`region` and `zone` over `region`) on the ObjectQL strategy's direct path answer `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 (`groupBy.1 names the column 'region'`), while native and the preview serve amer 150 / emea 30 keyed by both names. Same root as #28692 on the non-cross-object path; reported to the seat.
